fields.Name: T221 - Grid Column Management
fields.Description: Opens a grid's Columns panel and toggles a column's visibility, verifying column management.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the 'Products' entity grid — type 'Products' in the LEFT sidebar 'Search entities...' box and click it (or navigate to http://localhost:4200/app/data-explorer/Data?entity=Products). Wait for the grid to load. Click 'Configure view settings' (the sliders icon in the grid toolbar) to open the Configure View panel, then select its 'Columns' tab. Verify the column-management UI renders — it shows the grid's columns organized into 'Visible Columns' and 'Hidden Columns' lists (columns can be dragged between them). Seeing the Visible/Hidden Columns lists render is success — you do NOT need to actually move a column, and no error should appear. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Configure View panel's 'Columns' tab was opened
The column-management UI rendered, showing Visible Columns and Hidden Columns lists
No error messages or crash pages
